profiles.method: Modelled: from the measured ground on Lincoln Blvd below the toll plaza, straight lines to the roadway level at the south tower (67 m), a crest of 75 m at mid-span (the 67 m (220 ft) navigation clearance plus the deck), the north tower (67 m), and the measured ground at Vista Point. Positions are on the east sidewalk, the course's northbound lane.
profiles.name: Golden Gate Bridge, northbound
profiles.source: Golden Gate Bridge: 220 ft (67 m) clearance at mid-span (Golden Gate Bridge, Highway and Transportation District; Wikipedia); ends follow the measured approaches (USGS 3DEP lidar, San Francisco 2023 and northern California 2018); positions from OpenStreetMap

profiles.method: Modelled as the northbound profile, on the west sidewalk (the course's southbound lane): from the measured ground at the north end, over the north tower (67 m), the mid-span crest (75 m) and the south tower (67 m), to the measured ground at the toll plaza.
profiles.name: Golden Gate Bridge, southbound
